基于 Tailscale 的协议（WireGuard）：买卖双方都开启后，请求和: Built on Tailscale's protocol (WireGuard). When the buyer and the seller both have it on, requests and answers travel straight between the two machines instead of through the relays. When one side has it off, or a tunnel cannot be set up, requests go through the relays as before and nothing fails. It needs no Tailscale account, changes nothing in the system's network and needs no administrator rights. A tunnel starts through a DERP relay and moves to a direct path within seconds.
每条隧道通向一个对方：买模型时到卖家，共享模型时来自买家。连接 10 分钟没有新: Each tunnel leads to one peer: to a seller when you use a model, from a buyer when you share one. A connection closes after 10 minutes without a new request and is set up again by the next one.

等待时间需要是 0 到 10000 之间的整数（毫秒）: The wait must be a whole number of milliseconds from 0 to 10000
还没有隧道。和同样开启了直连隧道的对方有请求往来时才会建立。: No tunnel yet. One is set up when a request goes to or comes from a peer that has direct tunnels on as well.

隧道刚建立和打不通直连时经它中转，它只看到密文。留空使用公共中转服务器（DERP: A tunnel goes through these while it starts and whenever no direct path can be found; they see only ciphertext. Leave empty for the public DERP relays, or give the URL or the file path of a DERP map of your own. Buyer and seller need the same relays. Changing this rebuilds the tunnels.
隧道暂不可用，买家走中继：{error}: Not reachable through a tunnel for now, buyers use the relays: {error}
隧道里的连接跑在哪种协议上。只影响本机发起的连接（买模型时）；共享模型时两种都接: What a connection inside a tunnel runs on. It applies to the connections this device opens (when you use a model); when you share one, both are accepted. QUIC uploads large requests faster on a steady network; on a link that loses packets or jitters (weak Wi-Fi, for example) and with requests of several megabytes, TCP is steadier. A change applies to connections opened from then on.

成为共享伙伴后，你们双方都可以免费使用对方的节点，不扣 credit。伙伴的节点: As share partners, each of you uses the other’s nodes for free, with no credit charged. When your partner’s nodes are unavailable, requests go to the network and are paid. You can stop at any time.
配对后，你的账户只向配对的卖家购买，使用对方共享的 Claude、Codex 等: Once paired, your account buys only from the sellers it is paired with, using the Claude, Codex and other model quota they share. You can unpair at any time.
对方开启了确认：你接受后，需要对方确认才生效。: The sender asks to approve each use: after you accept, it takes effect once they approve.
这个邀请是从浏览器里的链接打开的。只在你认识对方时接受。: This invite was opened from a link in your browser. Accept it only if you know the sender.
配对码暂时停用：全站输错的次数太多。请改用邀请链接，或一小时后再试: Pairing codes are paused: too many wrong ones across the site. Use the invite link instead, or try again in an hour
连接后，工具的配置指向本机接口（修改前会备份）。保留官方登录时，模型菜单里官方模: Connecting points the tool's config at this endpoint (the file is backed up first). With the official login kept, the model menu lists ShareToken's models (st-…) after the official ones, and each request goes where its model is: official models on your own plan, st- models on the ShareToken network. The tools need this client running.
把 {name} 的配置恢复成连接前的样子？: Put {name}'s settings back as they were before?
未登录官方账号: not signed in to its vendor
保留 Claude 订阅登录（共存）: Keep the Claude subscription login (side by side)
保留 ChatGPT 登录（共存）: Keep the ChatGPT login (side by side)
用 Codex 内置的 OpenAI provider（以前的对话仍可见）: Use Codex's built-in OpenAI provider (earlier conversations stay listed)
额度已用完，{time} 前的请求由 ShareToken 处理: Plan used up: ShareToken answers until {time}
已转到 ShareToken {n} 次，最近一次用 {model}: Answered by ShareToken {n} times, last on {model}
订阅额度用完后自动转到 ShareToken 继续: Go on on ShareToken when the plan is used up
还没有看到 ChatGPT 订阅的用量: No ChatGPT plan usage seen yet
额度用到这个百分比时暂停官方模型: Hold official models at this share of a window
Codex Desktop 在订阅额度用完后会锁住输入框，连 ShareToke: Codex Desktop locks its input once the plan is used up, even for ShareToken models. Official models are held before that, with a note to switch to an st- model. With the unlock on they are not held.
额度用完后 Codex Desktop 不锁输入框，ShareToken 模型照: Codex Desktop does not lock its input when the plan is used up, so ShareToken models go on. Turning it on asks you to trust a certificate valid for localhost only and uses port {port} on this machine; Codex Desktop then needs this client running. Quit and reopen Codex Desktop afterwards.
登录系统时自动启动客户端（连接的工具需要它一直运行）: Start the client when you log in (the connected tools need it running)
登录系统时自动启动 ShareToken（窗口不打开，在托盘后台运行）: Start ShareToken when you log in (in the tray, without opening the window)
已开启：登录系统后 ShareToken 在后台运行，占用少量内存和网络；开启了: On: ShareToken runs in the background from login, using a little memory and network; with sharing on, it also sells in the background. If you quit ShareToken from the tray, the connected tools stop working until it is opened again.
未开启：电脑重启、注销，或从托盘退出 ShareToken 后，已连接的 Cla: Off: after a restart, a logout, or quitting ShareToken from the tray, the connected Claude Code and Codex cannot reach this endpoint, not even for their own official models (requests fail to connect), until ShareToken is opened again. If you keep this off, disconnect the tools (their settings are put back) before you stop using ShareToken.
未开启：连接 Claude Code 或 Codex 后，它们所有的请求（包括官: Off: once Claude Code or Codex is connected, all their requests, official models included, go through ShareToken; while ShareToken is not running, those tools do not work.
程序崩溃或出错时，把脱敏后的错误信息（错误类型、调用栈、崩溃前的程序日志）随你的: When the app crashes, it sends ShareToken a redacted report (the error, the stack trace and the app's log just before it) with your account, to help us fix it. It never contains your conversations, keys, email or IP addresses.
你所在的地区（欧洲经济区）默认关闭。: Off by default in your region (European Economic Area).
待发送的诊断报告: Crash reports waiting to be sent
下面就是会发送的全部内容，已经脱敏。关闭上报会清空它们。: This is everything that will be sent, already redacted. Turning reports off deletes them.
崩溃时会把脱敏后的错误信息随账户发给 ShareToken，不含对话内容和密钥。: When the app crashes, a redacted error report goes to ShareToken with your account; it never contains your conversations or keys. You can turn this off in Settings.
已开启异常诊断上报：崩溃时会把脱敏后的错误信息随账户发给 ShareToken，: Crash reports are on: when the app crashes, a redacted error report goes to ShareToken with your account, never your conversations or keys. You can turn this off in Settings.
